items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: And well it’s like in the Bird movie.

ctx.x: Amen. Swim or sink, you know. And well it’s like in the Bird movie. He goes in, he can’t play, they get rid of him, “get out of here.” Well, go home and practice and then come back later. He sure did.
But actually I mean well I consider myself, and I’m quite sure that Bill would be the same way, that we are very fortunate to make a living at music. I mean I feel blessed.
